chosen_titles.rationale: Title 21 (Public Officers and Employees) houses the main Arkansas lobbyist registration / expenditure / gift disclosure regime (Ch. 8 Subchapters 4-6).
Title 10 (General Assembly) Ch. 1 contains supporting legislative-branch lobbying provisions cross-referenced from the Title 21 disclosure regime.

notes: Justia returned a 'Page not found' for the 2025 Arkansas codes URL; falling back one year to 2024 per the handoff vintage-substitution rule. AR's lobbying-disclosure regime is split across two titles: Title 21 Ch. 8 (main lobbyist registration and disclosure body) and Title 10 Ch. 1 (legislative-branch supporting provisions).
